channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from PNallDR, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Trump to rally in city where alleged MS-13 leader was arrested
item.description: President Donald Trump is set to hold a rally in Grand Island, Nebraska, where an alleged MS-13 hit squad leader was arrested last year.

item.title: GOP PAC to spend $14 million for Kansas Sen. Marshall
item.description: The Senate Leadership Fund, a super PAC aligned with Senate Republican leadership, plans to spend $14 million in Kansas to support Sen. Roger Marshall.

item.title: Army leaders warn technology alone cannot ensure battlefield victory
item.description: Gen. Christopher LaNeve says command and control is the Army's top modernization priority as new leadership narrows its transformation push.
